parameters.formDescription: Upload a UI screenshot and optionally add error logs. The workflow drafts a Jira bug and attaches the screenshot.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: 'qwen/qwen3.6-27b', temperature: 0.1, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a QA engineer. Analyze only evidence visible in the screenshot and supplied logs. Return JSON with title, description, steps_to_reproduce (array), expected_behavior, actual_behavior, environment, severity (Blocker|Critical|Major|Minor|Trivial), and visual_clues (array). Clearly state when a detail is unknown; never invent interaction steps or technical causes.' }, { role: 'user', content: [ { type: 'text', text: `Analyze this UI screenshot. parameters.content:
## Trigger
Tester uploads one screenshot plus optional error logs.

## Actions
Groq vision creates a structured draft. Credentials are references; no API keys are stored in this file.

## Results
A Jira Bug is created and the submitted screenshot is attached.
